decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.algHom_ext_of_adjoin_eq_top
decls.doc:
**Two algebra homomorphisms agreeing on a generating set are equal.** If `s` generates `E`
over `F` (`IntermediateField.adjoin F s = ⊤`) and `F`-algebra maps `σ, τ : E →ₐ[F] E₂` (into any
semiring `E₂`) agree on every element of `s`, then `σ = τ`. This is the whole-field, two-map
counterpart of Mathlib's `IntermediateField.algHom_ext_of_eq_adjoin`.
decls.title: Two algebra homomorphisms agreeing on a generating set are equal
decls.statement:
theorem algHom_ext_of_adjoin_eq_top {E₂ : Type*} [Semiring E₂] [Algebra F E₂]
    (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin F s = ⊤)
    {σ τ : E →ₐ[F] E₂} (h : ∀ x ∈ s, σ x = τ x) : σ = τ

decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.algEquiv_ext_of_adjoin_eq_top
decls.doc: Two `F`-algebra automorphisms of `E` agreeing on a generating set are equal.
decls.statement:
theorem algEquiv_ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin F s = ⊤)
    {σ τ : E ≃ₐ[F] E} (h : ∀ x ∈ s, σ x = τ x) : σ = τ

decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.algEquiv_eq_one_of_adjoin_eq_top
decls.doc:
An `F`-algebra automorphism of `E` that fixes every element of a set generating `E` over
`F` is the identity. This is `TauCeti.IntermediateField.algEquiv_ext_of_adjoin_eq_top` against
the identity.
decls.statement:
theorem algEquiv_eq_one_of_adjoin_eq_top (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin F s = ⊤)
    {σ : E ≃ₐ[F] E} (hfix : ∀ x ∈ s, σ x = x) : σ = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.finite_setOf_exists_mem_eq_adjoin_simple_of_finite
decls.doc:
The simple intermediate fields generated by elements of a finite set `T` form a finite set.

This is the reusable finite-generator-to-simple-field counting step used before specializing to
particular finite generating sets.
decls.statement:
theorem finite_setOf_exists_mem_eq_adjoin_simple_of_finite {T : Set L} (hT : T.Finite) :
    {E : IntermediateField K L | ∃ x ∈ T, E = K⟮x⟯}.Finite

decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.ncard_setOf_exists_mem_eq_adjoin_simple_le
decls.doc:
The simple intermediate fields generated by elements of a finite set `T` are no more numerous
than the elements of `T`.
decls.statement:
theorem ncard_setOf_exists_mem_eq_adjoin_simple_le {T : Set L} (hT : T.Finite) :
    {E : IntermediateField K L | ∃ x ∈ T, E = K⟮x⟯}.ncard ≤ T.ncard

decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.mem_sup_adjoin_sq_of_exists
decls.doc: If `a` and `b` lie in `F`, then `a + b * x` lies in `F ⊔ K⟮x⟯`.

decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.isIntegral_of_sq_mem
decls.doc: If `x² ∈ F`, then `x` is integral over `F` (it is a root of `X² - x²`).
decls.statement:
theorem isIntegral_of_sq_mem {F : IntermediateField K L} {x : L} (hx2 : x ^ 2 ∈ F) :
    IsIntegral F x

decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.minpoly_natDegree_le_two_of_sq_mem
decls.doc:
If `x² ∈ F`, then the minimal polynomial of `x` over `F` has degree at most `2`, since it
divides the nonzero polynomial `X² - x²`.
decls.statement:
theorem minpoly_natDegree_le_two_of_sq_mem {F : IntermediateField K L} {x : L}
    (hx2 : x ^ 2 ∈ F) : (minpoly F x).natDegree ≤ 2

decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.exists_add_mul_of_mem_sup_adjoin_sq
decls.doc:
If `x² ∈ F`, every element of `F ⊔ K⟮x⟯` has the form `a + b * x` with
`a, b ∈ F`.

decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.mem_sup_adjoin_sq
decls.doc:
Membership in `F ⊔ K⟮x⟯`, for `x² ∈ F`, is equivalent to having the form `a + b * x`
with `a, b ∈ F`.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_sup_adjoin_sq {F : IntermediateField K L} {x : L}
    (hx2 : x ^ 2 ∈ F) {y : L} :
    y ∈ F ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin K {x} ↔
      ∃ a b : L, a ∈ F ∧ b ∈ F ∧ y = a + b * x

decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.mul_eq_zero_of_add_mul_sq_mem
decls.doc:
**Vanishing cross term in a quadratic step.** If `x² ∈ F` but `x ∉ F`, then a square
`(a + b * x) ^ 2` of a normal-form element that lands back in `F` has no cross term: `a * b = 0`.
This is where characteristic not two enters, through `2 ≠ 0` in `L`. It holds for an arbitrary
subfield `F` of `L`; no ambient base field or algebra tower is needed.
decls.title: Vanishing cross term in a quadratic step

decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.finrank_adjoin_simple_eq_two_of_sq_mem_notMem
decls.doc: If `x² ∈ F` but `x ∉ F`, then the simple extension `F⟮x⟯` has finrank two over `F`.

decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.finrank_restrictScalars_eq
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_restrictScalars_eq (F : IntermediateField K L)
    (E : IntermediateField F L) :
    Module.finrank K (E.restrictScalars K) = Module.finrank K E

decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.finrank_sup_adjoin_simple_eq_mul_two
decls.doc:
If `x² ∈ F` but `x ∉ F`, then adjoining `x` doubles the degree:
`[F ⊔ K⟮x⟯ : K] = 2 · [F : K]`.
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_sup_adjoin_simple_eq_mul_two (F : IntermediateField K L) {x : L}
    (hx2 : x ^ 2 ∈ F) (hxF : x ∉ F) :
    Module.finrank K ((F ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin K {x}) : IntermediateField K L)
      = Module.finrank K F * 2

decls.name: TauCeti.IntermediateField.isSquare_mul_of_adjoin_simple_eq
decls.doc:
**Same square class from a shared simple quadratic field.** Let `x` and `y` be square roots of
`a` and `c` in a field extension `L / K` with `2 ≠ 0`. If `x ∉ K` and the simple extensions `K(x)`
and `K(y)` coincide, then `a · c` is a square in `K`: two square roots generate the same quadratic
subfield only when their radicands lie in the same square class.
decls.title: Same square class from a shared simple quadratic field
decls.statement:
theorem isSquare_mul_of_adjoin_simple_eq [NeZero (2 : K)] {a c : K} {x y : L}
    (hx : x ^ 2 = algebraMap K L a) (hy : y ^ 2 = algebraMap K L c)
    (hxb : x ∉ (⊥ : IntermediateField K L))
    (hxy : IntermediateField.adjoin K {x} = IntermediateField.adjoin K {y}) :
    IsSquare (a * c)

decls.name: TauCeti.SquareClassGroup
decls.doc: **The square-class group** `Kˣ ⧸ (Kˣ)²`, written additively on `Additive Kˣ`.
decls.title: The square-class group
decls.statement: abbrev SquareClassGroup (K : Type*) [Field K] : Type _

decls.name: TauCeti.instModuleZModOfNatNatSquareClassGroup
decls.doc:
The square-class group is a `ZMod 2`-module: every element has order dividing two, since the
double of any unit class is the class of a square.
decls.statement: instance : Module (ZMod 2) (SquareClassGroup K)

decls.name: TauCeti.squareClass
decls.doc: The square class of a unit.
decls.statement: def squareClass (u : Kˣ) : SquareClassGroup K

decls.name: TauCeti.squareClass_eq_zero_iff
decls.doc: A unit has trivial square class iff it is a square.
decls.statement: theorem squareClass_eq_zero_iff (u : Kˣ) : squareClass u = 0 ↔ IsSquare u

decls.name: TauCeti.squareClass_prod
decls.doc: The square class of a product is the sum of the square classes.
decls.statement:
theorem squareClass_prod {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (d : ι → Kˣ) :
    squareClass (∏ i ∈ S, d i) = ∑ i ∈ S, squareClass (d i)

decls.name: TauCeti.zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one
decls.statement: theorem zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one (t : ZMod 2) : t = 0 ∨ t = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.sum_smul_squareClass
decls.doc:
A `ZMod 2`-linear combination of square classes is the class of the corresponding subset
product (the subset where the coefficient is `1`).
decls.statement:
theorem sum_smul_squareClass {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (d : ι → Kˣ)
    (g : ι → ZMod 2) :
    ∑ i, g i • squareClass (d i)
      = squareClass (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => g i = 1), d i)

decls.name: TauCeti.linearIndependent_squareClass_iff
decls.doc:
**Square-class independence is `ZMod 2`-linear independence.** For a finite family of units
`d : ι → Kˣ`, the square classes `squareClass (d i)` are `ZMod 2`-linearly independent in the
square-class group iff no nonempty subset product `∏_{i ∈ S} d i` is a square. The right-hand side
is the Finset form of square-class independence that the multiquadratic degree theorem consumes.
decls.title: Square-class independence is `ZMod 2`-linear independence
decls.statement:
theorem linearIndependent_squareClass_iff {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (d : ι → Kˣ) :
    LinearIndependent (ZMod 2) (fun i => squareClass (d i)) ↔
      ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → ¬ IsSquare (∏ i ∈ S, d i)

decls.name: TauCeti.Algebra.trace_eq_zero_of_sq_algebraMap_of_not_mem_range
decls.doc:
In a finite field extension, an element outside the base field whose square lies in the
base field has trace zero.
decls.statement:
theorem trace_eq_zero_of_sq_algebraMap_of_not_mem_range {F L : Type*} [Field F] [Field L]
    [Algebra F L] [FiniteDimensional F L] {x : L} {r : F}
    (hx2 : x ^ 2 = algebraMap F L r) (hx : x ∉ (algebraMap F L).range) :
    Algebra.trace F L x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Algebra.discr_one_elem_eq_of_sq_algebraMap
decls.doc:
For a quadratic extension `L / F` and an element `x ∉ F` whose square is `a ∈ F`, the
trace-form discriminant of the square-root basis `{1, x}` equals `4 a`.
decls.statement:
theorem discr_one_elem_eq_of_sq_algebraMap {x : L} {a : F} (hfin : finrank F L = 2)
    (hx2 : x ^ 2 = algebraMap F L a) (hx : x ∉ (algebraMap F L).range) :
    Algebra.discr F ![1, x] = 4 * a

decls.name: TauCeti.NumberField.trace_eq_zero_of_sq_ratCast
decls.doc: In a number field, an irrational element whose square is rational has trace zero.
decls.statement:
theorem trace_eq_zero_of_sq_ratCast {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    {x : K} {r : ℚ} (hx2 : x ^ 2 = algebraMap ℚ K r)
    (hx : x ∉ (algebraMap ℚ K).range) :
    Algebra.trace ℚ K x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.NumberField.trace_eq_zero_of_sq_ratCast_of_not_mem_range
decls.doc: Deprecated compatibility alias for the old NumberField helper name.
decls.statement: alias trace_eq_zero_of_sq_ratCast_of_not_mem_range
